notes: Searches identified leads only; no product or price snippets were treated as evidence.
BM, BT, BZ and CF online-search outputs were clipped before review; each query was issued once, none was repeated, and no finding is inferred from unavailable output.
Robots checks used direct requests. HTTP 403 means the robots policy was unavailable, not that all pages on the host are inaccessible.
No merchant, shop, catalog, offer or terms page was opened. No source is claimed as covered; current promos, terms/reuse and applicability remain unverified where stated.
No CAPTCHA, login, API key, private API, hidden endpoint or app-only data was accessed.
